name: boostrap-select-country-data
description: Bootstrap Select data helpers for countries, languages, timezones, US states, and UK counties with optional grouping and flag icons.
author: undefined

scripts.test: node -e "const pkg=require('./index.js'); const assertCollection=(name, value)=>{ if (!value) throw new Error(name + ' failed'); const flat=Array.isArray(value)?value:Object.values(value||{}).flat(); if (!flat.length) throw new Error(name + ' failed'); }; const countries=pkg.countries({ include: pkg.include.countries(['Albania','Brunei','Iceland','Malta']) }); if (!countries.some((country)=>country.value==='AL')) throw new Error('country include filter failed'); const excludedCountries=pkg.countries({ exclude: pkg.exclude.countries(['Albania','Brunei']) }); if (excludedCountries.some((country)=>country.value==='AL' || country.value==='BN')) throw new Error('country exclude filter failed'); const languageSamples=pkg.countryLanguages(); const languageMatch=languageSamples.find((item)=>item.value==='fr_FR'||item.value==='en_US'||item.value==='de_AT'); if (!languageMatch || typeof languageMatch.value !== 'string' || !languageMatch.languageCode || !languageMatch.languageName) throw new Error('language option contract failed'); const languages=pkg.countryLanguages({ include: pkg.include.language(['fr_FR','en_US']) }); if (!languages.length) throw new Error('language include filter failed'); const tz=pkg.timezones({ include: pkg.include.timezones(['Europe/London']) }); if (!tz.some((zone)=>zone.value==='Europe/London')) throw new Error('timezone include filter failed'); const states=pkg.usStates({ include: pkg.include.states(['California']) }); if (!states.some((state)=>state.value==='California')) throw new Error('state include filter failed'); const counties=pkg.ukCounties({ include: pkg.include.counties(['Greater London']) }); if (!counties.some((county)=>county.value==='Greater London')) throw new Error('county include filter failed'); assertCollection('countries', pkg.countries({groupByRegion:true, includeFlags:true})); assertCollection('languages', pkg.countryLanguages({groupByRegion:true, includeFlags:true})); assertCollection('timezones', pkg.timezones({groupByContinent:true})); assertCollection('states', pkg.usStates({groupByRegion:true})); assertCollection('counties', pkg.ukCounties({groupByRegion:true})); console.log('bootstrap-select-country-data ok');"
